entries.title: Ask HN: Favorite purchases of last two years?
entries.author: wyldfire
entries.current_title: Ask HN: Favorite purchases of last two years?
entries.excerpt: I've abandoned all faith in reviews online. But the HN crew can give good advice and are extremely unlikely to shill garbage. Consumer Reports is great for finding which manufacturer/model to buy. But what product or service did you buy that you found really useful/entertaining? I'll start: I caved and bought a robovac. Wow, unlike many techno-gadgets, this one really delivers. Real utility, not just taking up space. Low maintenance, runs while I sleep, and the floor is just
entries.guide_zh: 过去两年买过什么好东西，发帖者希望借亲身体验替代不可信的网络评测。

entries.title: Ask HN: Are you satisfied with Elixir or do you regret choosing Elixir?
entries.author: sdiw
entries.current_title: Ask HN: Are you satisfied with Elixir or do you regret choosing Elixir?
entries.excerpt: I'll be starting to work on a new project from next month and I've been reading all but good news about Elixir. I have talked to people in real life, most of the devs had positive things to say about it. Does anyone have any arguments against selecting Elixir? Question coming from RoR developer.
entries.guide_zh: 新项目考虑使用 Elixir，想听采用者的满意之处与后悔之处。

entries.title: Ask HN: How to negotiate continuing to work remotely?
entries.author: megasquid
entries.current_title: Ask HN: How to negotiate continuing to work remotely?
entries.excerpt: Hi HN. Like many of you I am working remotely due to COVID. I want to continue working remotely, but my job wants me in the office next month. How would you negotiate this with your employer? Have any of you already had this conversation? How did it go?
entries.guide_zh: 疫情后想继续远程办公，如何与原本要求到办公室的雇主谈判？

entries.title: Ask HN: What are some tools / libraries you built yourself?
entries.author: graderjs
entries.current_title: Ask HN: What are some tools / libraries you built yourself?
entries.excerpt: Many times you just want to plug something in. PostgreSQL, Node.JS Express, Java Spring, numpy, Three.js. There's many examples where the already existing solution fits well. Sometimes that's not good enough tho. What are some tools, libraries or services you built, are they open-source and why weren't you satisfied using what already existed?
entries.guide_zh: 现成库之外，你亲手写过哪些工具或库，解决了什么具体需求？

entries.title: Ask HN: How to cope with the death of a dear person?
entries.author: simonebrunozzi
entries.current_title: Ask HN: How to cope with the death of a dear person?
entries.excerpt: My father-in-law passed away three days ago. As it happens with these things, it was too soon. It's always too soon. He was like a second father to me. He had a career in the Italian navy, a retired Admiral. He was a great storyteller, and had a tough and difficult character, but lots of good things, deep inside. Full of integrity, honorable. Thankfully we moved back to Italy a few months ago after a dozen years abroad, and spent this time mostly with him and his wife, in the
entries.guide_zh: 亲人刚刚离世，发帖者寻求面对失去、哀伤和突然告别的经验。
